page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No marginal notes. Page number and running head at the top, catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: guiore exhalatione, frigore nocturno concretâ, & motu accensâ, ardentis candelæ formâ apparet.
Hic ad motü aeris agitatus loca potisimùm præcipitia petit: id quod noctu iter facientes experiuntur.
In locis deniq; terræ cavernosis amplioribus hujusmodi meteora ignita apparent, propter easdè[?] causas: quæ frequenter illis, qui subtus terram in fodinis operantur, conspiciuntur.

head.i: Ignitis meteoris simplicibus, succedunt cuj-dem generis flatulenta.

main_text.p: Flatulentum sive aereum meteoron est, quod exfu-mis ficcis inter ascendendum deorsum repulsis exsistens, aerem spirando flandoq; commovet & agitat.
Ventus est à fumo ficciore, inter ascendendum vi frigoris in medio aere deorsum obliquè repul-so, aeremq; inferiorem commovente.
Venti sunt alii universales, alii particulares.
universales venti sunt, qui universa terræ loca habitabilia perflant.
Hi tum ab Ortu & Occasu, tum à Meridie & Septentrione, terni proveniunt.
Inter quos medius semper Cardinalis, ab aliquo cardine Mundi præcisè, reliqui duo Collaterales cardinali, exoriuntur.

page.notes: Doubtful: "easdè" (line 4 of the paragraph beginning "In locis"), read with [?]. Ignored: the printer's mark at the top right corner, the library stamp at the bottom left. The first word "guiore" is a fragment continuing from the previous page and is kept as printed.
